libs.note: BH-10211 C0: the shadow-read counter of prr_read (bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh). Each shadow read adds 1 to agree, mismatch, miss (+ miss.<word>) or skip in logs/prr-count/<lane>/<UTC day>.tsv. bin/prr-shadow-ready.sh reads it and prints READY or NOT READY per gh_source lane, the evidence a person reads before moving lane.<id>.gh_source to record.

knobs.note: BH-10211. READY needs the oldest kept counted shadow read of the lane to be at least this many hours old. Read in bin/prr-shadow-ready.sh as PRR_READY_HOURS (resolved by bin/lib/prr-count.sh), code fallback 48.

BH-10211. READY needs at least this many shadow reads where the record and GitHub agreed, summed over the kept day files. Read in bin/prr-shadow-ready.sh as PRR_READY_MIN_AGREED (resolved by bin/lib/prr-count.sh), code fallback 100.

BH-10211. The RETENTION of logs/prr-count: when prr_count_add creates a new day file, it deletes that lane's day files older than this many days. It is also the READY window. Read in bin/lib/prr-count.sh as PRR_COUNT_KEEP_DAYS, code fallback 14.

BH-10211. The longest prr_count_add waits for the day file's lock. On a timeout it writes nothing and the lane goes on (an undercount; the READY check also counts PRR_SHADOW log lines). Read in bin/lib/prr-count.sh as PRR_COUNT_LOCK_S, code fallback 2.
